detail.name: Hugo's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Hugo's Mindscape: Fruit of the Poisonous Tree
detail.desc2:
A card featuring the image of a famous phantom thief.
On the back, bold letters read: "The one and only in all of New Eridu", accompanied by a flamboyant handwritten signature.
After all, if everyone recognized this gentleman thief... he might be doomed to endlessly change identities on the ever-shifting stage of light and shadow.
